public.how.title: Efi dua da so kosi baabi a nnɔbae no adu
public.how.lead: Mpɛn pii, wɔde nsa na ɛkyerɛw baabi a nnɔbae no adu, enti ɛyɛ foforo sɛnea wɔyɛɛ no nea etwa to. Ɛha de, wɔde wim tebea a wɔakyerɛw ato hɔ na ebu, na nsakrae biara kora nea egyina so.
public.step.1.title: Kyerɛw nea okuafo no nim
public.step.1.body: Wɔkora afuw, afuw nketewa, nnɔbae ne dua nna wɔ Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Fa wim tebea a atwam no bra
public.step.2.body: Wɔfa afuw no da biara ɔhyew fi Open-Meteo nsɛm dedaw mu, efi dua da so kosi nnɛ.
public.step.3.title: Bu ɔhyew nna no bom
public.step.3.body: Wɔde nnɔbae nhwɛso no bu ɔhyew nna (GDD) no bom. Sɛ ɛtra dodow a wɔahyɛ no a, nhyehyɛe no de bere no kɔ ɔfã a edi hɔ na ɛkyerɛw nea egyina so.
public.models.title: Nnɔbae nhwɛso a wɔde redi dwuma
public.models.lead: Ɔhyew nna a nnɔbae no hia ansa na abere. Wɔde nsa na ɛkyerɛw nhyehyɛe yi, na wonnyaa baabi a nsɛm no fi.
public.live.title: Swartland sɔhwɛ afuw no tebea
public.live.lead: Nsɛm fi mmeae a obiara betumi anya, na wɔyɛ no foforo simma 30 biara.
public.yields.title: Nnɔbae dodow a wɔde toto ho a wɔatintim
public.honesty.title: Sɛnea wɔhwɛ nsɛm no so
public.honesty.1.title: Ɔhwɛfo no na ɔkyerɛw nnɔbae dodow no
public.honesty.1.body: Kosi sɛ ɔhwɛfo bɛkyerɛw nnɔbae dodow a wonyae no, app no bɛkyerɛ “Wɔnkyerɛwee”.
public.honesty.2.title: Ntotoho akontaabu no wɔ n'ankasa kyerɛwtohɔ
public.honesty.2.body: Wɔde mantam ne ɔman akontaabu sie n'ankasa nkrataa mu, na wɔkyerɛ baabi a efi ne susudua. Wɔmfa ntoto afuw bi nnɔbae ho.
public.honesty.3.title: Mmoawa kyerɛwtohɔ no yɛ mantam de
public.honesty.3.body: Wɔkyerɛ GBIF kyerɛwtohɔ sɛ mmeae a wohuu mmoawa no wɔ 100 km ntam, ne kwan tenten no.
public.honesty.4.title: Wim tebea no yɛ nea ɛrekɔ so seesei
public.honesty.4.body: Sɛ wobisa a, wɔfa ɔhyew ho nsɛm fi Open-Meteo kyerɛwtohɔ mu.
public.open.title: Bue bere bi
public.open.body: Kɔ demo dashboard no mu na hwɛ bere no GDD nsensanee ne adanse a ɛkyerɛ ne gyinabea.

public.yield.lead: Nsensanee abiɛsa no susuw nneɛma foforo wɔ mmeae ahorow, enti wontumi mfa ntoto wɔn ho anaa afuw bi ho.
public.about.title: Ho nsɛm
public.about.heading: Mecropolis ho nsɛm
public.about.lead: Mecropolis yɛ afuw ne nnɔbae akyi di app ma afuw bi a ɛwɔ Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Nea enti a ɛwɔ hɔ
public.about.why.body: Nnɔbae gyinabea ho nsɛm tumi kyɛ, na wɔde wɔn adwene mu nnɔbae dodow hyɛ mu. Mecropolis de wim tebea a wɔakyerɛw bu gyinabea no. Akontaabu biara fi ɔhwɛfo anaa ɔmanfo fibea a wɔabɔ din.
public.about.design.title: Sɛnea wɔyɛɛ no
public.about.design.1.body: Efi da a woduae no, wɔde Open-Meteo kyerɛwtohɔ boaboa ɔhyew nna ano. Sɛ gyinabea sesa a, wɔsie adanse no: da a efii ase, GDD dodow ne nea wɔde buae.
public.about.design.2.body: Wɔfrɛ gyinabea a edi otwa anim akyi no ɔhyew mu nyinwie, efisɛ wɔankyerɛw sɛ wɔatwa nnɔbae no.
public.about.design.4.lead: Ntotoho akontaabu no ma yehu tebea no.
public.about.design.4.body: Wɔde sie n'ankasa nkrataa mu, na wɔkyerɛ fibea, susudua ne tumi krataa.
public.about.stack.title: Mfiridwuma a wɔde yɛe
public.about.stack.body: Ɛyɛ Vite ne React 19 kratafa baako app wɔ Cloudflare Pages so. Browser no de GROQ ne tiefo a ɔyɛ adwuma bere ankasa mu kenkan Sanity nsɛm a obiara betumi ahwɛ no tẽẽ. Nsɛm a wɔkyerɛw ne nsɛm a ehia safoa fa Cloudflare Pages Functions so; ɛno hwɛ session cookie a wɔahyɛ ase no mu. Wɔde Zod hwɛ nsɛm a ɛhyɛn ne nea efi mu, Vitest sɔ hwɛ, na Tailwind 4 yɛ ne hwɛbea.
public.about.limits.title: Nea yenim sɛ ɛtɔ sin
public.about.limits.1: Wɔde nsa na ɛkyerɛw nnɔbae nhwɛso no akontaahyɛde (ɔhyew a efi ase, ɔhyew bere a ɛma ɛfifi ne nea ɛma ɛnyin wie), na wonnyaa fibea biara mmaa no.
public.about.limits.2: Lupin ntotoho akontaabu no fi HarvestStat, efi 2000 kosi 2007 nkutoo, na bere a wɔde mfitiase nsɛm hyɛɛ mu no, wɔannya lupin ntotoho krataa biara.
public.about.limits.3: Mmoawa ho nsɛm no yɛ GBIF kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛbɛn afuw no. Ɛkyerɛ baabi a wɔkyerɛw sɛ wohuu abɔde bi wɔ afuw no ho.
public.about.limits.4: Demo no wɔ akaw baako a obiara de kɔ mu ne anohyeto a ɛwɔ memory mu. Kɔ mu no de dashboard nkratafa no sie, nanso ɛmmɔ nsɛm no ho ban: obiara betumi akenkan nsɛm no. Nanso ɛbɔ nsɛm a wɔkyerɛw nyinaa ho ban.

docs.stages.intro: Bere no kɔ anim fa gyinabea asia mu:
docs.stages.guards: Anammɔn biara wɔ nea ɛsɛ sɛ edi kan. Duae hia da a woduae ne nnɔbae; nyin hia ɔhyew nna dodow a ɛma ɛfifi; otwa anim hia nyinwie dodow no 90%; ɔhyew mu nyinwie hia sɛ edu nyinwie dodow no; nhwehwɛmu hia bere no wim tebea mfonini ne ntotoho akontaabu a wɔawie. GDD nhwehwɛmu nso hia ɔhyew ho nsɛm ma bere no mu anyɛ yiye koraa 90%, na sɛ anammɔn no da wɔ daakye a, wɔmma ɛnkɔ so.

guide.title: Sɛnea wɔde Mecropolis di dwuma
guide.lead: Akwankyerɛ tiawa a emu da hɔ. Ɛkyerɛ nea app no yɛ, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ne nea emu fã biara yɛ.
guide.what.title: Nea Mecropolis yɛ
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis yɛ app a wɔde hwɛ mfuw ne nnɔbae so. Ɛde ɔhyew a nnɔbae bi anya fi bere a woduae no bom, na ɛkyerɛ baabi a ne nyin adu. Afei nso, ɛma wuhu wim tebea, asase ne mmoawa a wɔwɔ w’afuw ho wɔ baabi biako.
guide.what.p2: Wɔyɛɛ no maa mfuw a ɛwɔ Western Cape wɔ South Africa, nanso wobetumi de saa kwan yi adi dwuma wɔ afuw, mpɔtam ne bere biara mu.
guide.who.title: Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma
guide.who.p1: Ɛyɛ ma obi a ɔhwɛ mfuw so, te sɛ okuafo, afuw sohwɛfo anaa afotufo a ɔboa wɔn.
guide.who.p2: Ɛho nhia sɛ wunim kɔmputa anaa wim tebea ho nyansa. Sɛ wubetumi abue wɛbsaet a, wubetumi de Mecropolis adi dwuma.
guide.why.title: Nea enti a wode bedi dwuma
guide.why.1: Wubetumi ahu ntɛm nnɔbae a wɔaduaduae, nea ɛrenyin ne nea ɛreyɛ adu twabere.
guide.why.2: Ɛho nhia sɛ wo nsa na ɛde afuw biara ho nsɛm yɛ foforo, efisɛ sɛ wim tebea kyerɛ sɛ bere aso a, app no ankasa de nnɔbae no kɔ anim.
guide.why.3: Ɛbɔ wo kɔkɔ wɔ awɔw a ɛbɛyɛ nsukyenee ne ɔhyew a ɛbɛba nna kakra mu, ne mmoawa a wohuu wɔn wɔ w’afuw ho.
guide.why.4: Biribiara a wɔakyerɛw afa afuw ho, te sɛ aduru a wɔde petee, mmoawa a wuhuu anaa kyerɛwtohɔ, tena baabi biako a ne da ka ho, na woatumi ahwɛ akyiri.
guide.why.5: Nɔma biara kyerɛ baabi a efi, enti wubehu nea wubetumi de wo ho ato so.
guide.heat.title: Sɛnea app no hu baabi a nnɔbae no adu
guide.heat.p1: Sɛ ɔhyew wɔ hɔ a, afifide nyin ntɛmntɛm; sɛ awɔw wɔ hɔ a, ɛnyin brɛoo. Da biara Mecropolis kan ɔhyew yi sɛ ɔhyew dodow a nyansahufo frɛ no growing degree days anaa GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Da biara, ɛfa ɔhyew a ɛkorɔn ne nea ɛba fam no ntam, na eyi ɔhyew a nnɔbae no gyae nyin wɔ mu no fi mu. Nea aka no ne da no ɔhyew dodow. Sɛ awɔw yɛ den a, biribiara nka ho.
guide.heat.p3: Nnɔbae biara hia ɔhyew dodow pɔtee ansa na ayɛ krado. Bere a ɔhyew a anya fi bere a woduae no rebɛn saa dodow no, nnɔbae no kɔ ne nyin fã a edi hɔ.
guide.heat.p4: Open-Meteo na ɛma ɔhyew ho nsɛm no. Ɛyɛ wim tebea dwumadi a wontua hwee, na ɛkyerɛw wiase baabiara wim tebea.
guide.stages.title: Nyin afã asia no
guide.stages.intro: Nnɔbae biara a ɛwɔ afuw biara so fa saa afã yi mu nnidiso nnidiso.
guide.stages.planning: Wɔahyehyɛ bere no, nanso wonnya nnuae.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Nnɔbae no anya ɔhyew a ehia no fã kɛse, enti ɛsɛ sɛ wosiesie wo ho ma otwa.
guide.stages.harvested: Nnɔbae no anya ɔhyew a ehia no nyinaa, enti ɛsɛ sɛ ayɛ krado. Wo nkutoo na wubetumi aka sɛ wɔatwa ampa, enti app no frɛ eyi ɔhyew mu nyinwie.
guide.stages.review: Bere no aba awiei, na wubetumi ahwɛ sɛnea ɛkɔe.
guide.stages.p2: App no hwɛ nnɔbae biara anadwo biara ne bere biara a obi de nea ohui anaa aduru a ɔde yɛɛ adwuma ka ho. Wubetumi nso mia Reconcile now wɔ bere bi so na woahwɛ no ntɛm ara.
guide.start.title: Sɛnea wobefi ase
guide.start.1: Bue fie kratafa no. Wubetumi ahu wim tebea map, asase, mmoawa ne nnɔbae dodow ma nhwɛso afuw no a wonkɔɔ mu.
guide.start.2: Mia Sign in wɔ soro, na fa nhwɛso akontaabu ho nsɛm a wɔde maa wo no di dwuma.
guide.start.3: Paw afuw bi. Eyi bue saa afuw no dashboard.
guide.start.4: Mia bere bi so na wubehu saa nnɔbae biako a ɛwɔ saa afuw biako so no ho nsɛm nyinaa.
guide.start.5: Fa kasa adaka a ɛwɔ kratafa biara soro no sesa kasa no. Sɛ wosan ba a, app no kae nea wopaw.
guide.home.title: Fie kratafa
guide.home.p1: Fie kratafa no kyerɛ mpɔtam no map a wɔde kɔla akyerɛ ɔhyew dodow a asase no anya saa bere yi. Ɛsan kyerɛ mprempren wim tebea ne nna kakra a edi hɔ de, nhwɛso afuw no asase, mmoawa a wohuu wɔn wɔ hɔ nnansa yi, ne mpɔtam no nnɔbae dodow a wɔtaa nya. Ɛho nhia sɛ wokɔ mu ansa na woahu.
guide.dashboard.title: Afuw dashboard
guide.dashboard.intro: Dashboard no kyerɛ afuw biako. Efi kratafa no soro kosi ase, eyinom ne emu afã. Afuw adaka a ɛwɔ soro no ma wutumi kɔ afuw foforo so.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Afuw no ho nsɛm tiawa
guide.dashboard.summary: Mfuw dodow ne ha dodow a afuw no wɔ, mmere dodow a ɛrekɔ so ne nnɔbae dodow a ayɛ krado.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Nea ehia sɛ wohwɛ
guide.dashboard.alerts: Kɔkɔbɔ tiawa te sɛ awɔw a ɛbɛyɛ nsukyenee anaa ɔhyew a wɔahyɛ ho nkɔm, nnɔbae a ayɛ krado, bere a amfi ase wɔ bere ano, anaa mmoawa a wohuu wɔn wɔ afuw bi ho. Kɔkɔbɔ biara kyerɛ nea ɛde bae.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Afuw no tebea
guide.dashboard.conditions: Ɛnnɛ wim tebea, nea wɔahyɛ ho nkɔm, asase ne mmoawa a wɔwɔ afuw yi ho.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Bere no nkɔso
guide.dashboard.progress: Krataa bi wɔ hɔ ma nnɔbae biara a ɛkyerɛ ɔhyew a anya. Wubetumi de mfuw atoto ho, na woatwe din no sɛ spreadsheet fael (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Mfuw
guide.dashboard.fields: Afuw no mu mfuw nyinaa ne emu biara kɛse, asase ne nnɔbae.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Hwehwɛ kyerɛwtohɔ
guide.dashboard.search: Kyerɛw nea worehwehwɛ no wɔ kasa a yɛka daa mu, te sɛ aphids wɔ awi so. Ɛhwehwɛ nea wohui ne aduru a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma a nkyerɛase yɛ pɛ, sɛ wɔde nsɛmfua foforo mpo dii dwuma a.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Afotu
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Adwuma a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma afuw bi, te sɛ aduru a wɔde bɛpete anaa afifide aduan. Wubetumi agye biara atom anaa woapo, na sɛ wowie adwuma no a, woahyɛ no sɛ wɔayɛ.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Nnansa yi dwumadi
guide.dashboard.activity: Bere a nnɔbae biara kɔɔ nyin fã foforo no din.
guide.season.title: Bere kratafa
guide.season.intro: Bere yɛ nnɔbae biako a ɛwɔ afuw biako so wɔ afe biako mu. Ne kratafa no wɔ ne ho nsɛm nyinaa.
guide.season.top.label: Kratafa no soro
guide.season.top: Nnɔbae no, afuw no, dua da, otwa da a wɔhwɛ kwan ne nnɔbae dodow bere a wode ahyɛ mu.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Nyin afã nnidiso
guide.season.pipeline: Nyin afã asia no a wɔahyɛ nea ɛwɔ so mprempren no agyirae. Mia Reconcile now na hwɛ ntɛm ara sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ nnɔbae no kɔ anim anaa.
guide.season.readiness.label: Nea ehia ansa na wɔasi gyinae
guide.season.readiness: Nea app no hia ansa na atumi de nnɔbae no akɔ anim, te sɛ dua da ne wim tebea ho nsɛm a ɛdɔɔso. Ade biara kyerɛ Pass, Warning anaa Blocked, na nea wɔasiw no kyerɛ nea ɛnni hɔ.
guide.season.evidence.label: Adanse
guide.season.evidence: Kyerɛwtohɔ a app no de sii gyinae, na woatumi ahwɛ.
guide.season.propose.label: Fa afotu bi to gua
guide.season.propose: Kamfo adwuma bi kyerɛ ma afuw yi, na fa bere no adanse ka ho. Ɛbɛtwɛn sɛ nsusuwii kosi sɛ obi begye atom wɔ dashboard no so.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Mfonini a ɛkyerɛ ɔhyew dodow a ɛboaboa ano fi bere a woduae, ne nsensanee a ɛkyerɛ dodow a nnɔbae no hia.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Sɛ ɛba saa nso ɛ?
guide.season.whatIf: Sɔ dua da a edi kan anaa ɛkyɛ, anaa bere a ɛyɛ hyew anaa awɔw kɛse, na hwɛ sɛnea ɔhyew dodow no bɛsesa. Wɔrensie biribiara.
guide.season.summary.label: Bere no ho nsɛm tiawa
guide.season.summary: Bere no kyerɛwtohɔ ho nsɛm tiawa a AI akyerɛw. Fa no sɛ ɔboafo, na sɛ biribi te sɛ nea ɛnyɛ nokware a, hwɛ kyerɛwtohɔ no.
guide.season.notes.label: Bere no ho kyerɛwtohɔ
guide.season.notes: Bere no ho kyerɛwtohɔ a nna ka ho. Wubetumi de bi aka ho, asesa anaa woayi afi hɔ, na woasan de kyerɛwtohɔ dedaw aba.
guide.season.files.label: Afuw mfonini ne asase sɔhwɛ amanneɛbɔ
guide.season.files: Fa afuw no mfonini ne asase sɔhwɛ PDF a efi lab no gu so.
guide.season.log.label: Afuw kyerɛwtohɔ
guide.season.log: Nea wuhuu wɔ afuw no mu ne nea wode yɛɛ no, te sɛ aduru a wopetee ne aduru no din ne dodow.
guide.season.history.label: Nsakrae abakɔsɛm
guide.season.history: Nsakrae biara a wɔde asie wɔ bere yi mu ne ne da.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Mpɔtam gyinapɛn
guide.season.benchmark: Mpɔtam no nnɔbae dodow a wɔtaa nya a efi ɔmanfo akontaabu mu. Ɛwɔ hɔ ma ntotoho, na ɛnyɛ wo mfuw no nnɔbae dodow.
guide.season.pests.label: Mmoawa a wohuu wɔn wɔ mpɔtam hɔ
guide.season.pests: Mmoawa a wɔbɔɔ wɔn ho amanneɛ wɔ afuw no ho wɔ GBIF, ɔmanfo nsɛm korabea a ɛkyerɛ nea nkurɔfo ahu. Mia Fetch sightings na nya nea aba foforo.
guide.sources.title: Baabi a nɔma no fi
guide.sources.weather: Ɛnnɛ, daakye ne nna a atwam wim tebea ho nsɛm fi Open-Meteo.
guide.sources.soil: Asase ho nsɛm fi SoilGrids, wiase asase map.
guide.sources.pests: Mmoawa a wohuu wɔn ho nsɛm fi GBIF, ɔmanfo nsɛm korabea a ɛkyerɛ nea nkurɔfo ahu.
guide.sources.yields: Mpɔtam nnɔbae dodow fi USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ne World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Nsɛm a aka nyinaa, te sɛ kyerɛwtohɔ, aduru a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma ne wo ara nnɔbae dodow, yɛ nea wo anaa wo kuw no kyerɛwee.
guide.limits.title: Nea entumi nyɛ
guide.limits.model: Ɔhyew dodow a yɛabu sɛ nnɔbae biara hia no yɛ yɛn ara akontaabu, na yɛnsɔɔ nhwɛ wɔ afuw mu. Fa no sɛ akwankyerɛ, na gye nea wuhu wɔ w’afuw mu di.
guide.limits.maturity: Sɛ wim tebea kyerɛ sɛ nnɔbae no bere aso a, ɛno ne thermal maturity. Wo nko ara na wunim sɛ ɛbere aso ampa.
guide.limits.translation: AI na ɛkyerɛw nkyerɛase yi. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛte ase, nanso obi a ɔka kasa no amfa ne nyinaa mu nhwɛɛ.
guide.limits.demo: Obiara betumi de demo no adi dwuma, enti mfa kokoam nsɛm biara nhyɛ mu.
